stop_reason: Maximum iteration limit reached (max_iterations=2) and the two completed iterations have surfaced a sufficient set of authoritative candidate sources covering the primary target fields. Further searching is not permitted within the stated bounds.
final_coverage_assessment:
Good coverage across the primary target fields:
- **disease**: Confirmed (West Nile virus / WNV across all sources)
- **country**: Confirmed (United States, implied by all .gov and California sources)
- **subnational_location**: Confirmed (California statewide from CDPH/westnile.ca.gov; county-level from glamosquito.org, kernpublichealth.com, dhs.saccounty.net, countyofsb.org, nevadacountyca.gov, kcra.com)
- **locality**: Partially covered (glamosquito.org provides neighborhood/city-level data for LA County in August 2024; other counties at county level only)
- **date_reported**: Partially covered (glamosquito.org has specific August 2024 dates; CDPH weekly PDFs have epi-week dates that must be confirmed from PDF content; kcra.com article date not confirmed in snippet)
- **cases_confirmed / cases_probable**: Covered via CDPH weekly PDFs (neuroinvasive + non-neuroinvasive classification maps to confirmed; probable cases may be in PDF tables)
- **cases_suspected / cases_unspecified**: Not explicitly surfaced in snippets; may be in CDPH PDF tables
- **deaths**: Partially covered (kcra.com snippet mentions 5 deaths including Sacramento and Yolo counties; nevadacountyca.gov mentions 3 deaths — these are different time points, suggesting temporal progression)
- **hospitalizations**: Not explicitly surfaced in snippets; likely in CDPH weekly PDF tables (neuroinvasive disease is a proxy)
- **source_url**: Multiple candidate URLs identified across both iterations
- **source_type**: Both official_public_health_agency and news_and_situation_report represented
- **evidence_quote**: Snippets from westnile.ca.gov PDFs, glamosquito.org, kcra.com, and nevadacountyca.gov provide extractable quote candidates
final_trustworthiness_assessment:
High trustworthiness for the primary sources:
- westnile.ca.gov (CDPH official WNV portal): Tier-1 authoritative; state agency; .ca.gov domain; weekly PDF reports with structured surveillance data
- glamosquito.org (Greater LA County Vector Control District): Tier-2 authoritative; official vector control district; locality-level August 2024 case dates directly in target window
- kernpublichealth.com and dhs.saccounty.net: Tier-2 authoritative; county official health agencies; .gov or official county domains
- cdc.gov historic data: Tier-1 authoritative; federal agency; ArboNET attribution
- kcra.com: Tier-3 (news); regional Sacramento TV station; credible for California WNV coverage; snippet cites specific county-level death locations
- nevadacountyca.gov: Tier-2 authoritative; county government; .gov domain; but figures (13 cases, 3 deaths) appear to be an early-season snapshot, not August-specific
- cola.org: Lower trust for primary evidence; laboratory accreditation organization, not a public health surveillance agency — useful only as secondary context
- Excluded: facebook.com, youtube.com, wikipedia.org, dph.illinois.gov (out-of-jurisdiction), researchgate.net (not primary data)
